dsh-github-login 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。零终端的 GitHub 可视化登录插件：窗口内完成设备码授权，令牌同步进 gh CLI，附宿主端状态与唤起接口。

posts.en:
dsh-github-login is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ffabae9558726cb43782.html
